capabilities: Chat with AI models in a sidebar bubble interface
Reference notes and folders via @ mentions in chat
Query the whole vault with RAG retrieval and source citations
Fetch web pages and search Bing and arXiv via built-in tools
Configure chat, embedding, and rerank models across many providers
disambiguation: Not the Aider pair-programming CLI tool; it is a standalone Obsidian chat assistant that happens to share the name.
extras: Supports fully local offline models via Ollama and LM Studio, and includes rate-limit backoff aimed at free-tier providers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so users switch to external chat apps that lack context from their notes.

relations.evidence: deeply inspired by the design ideas and architecture of obsidian-smart-composer

requires.name: AI provider API key (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, and others)

summary: Sidebar AI chat companion that answers questions about the active note or the whole vault using configurable LLM providers with retrieval-augmented search.
